title: The Role of Binding Site Specificity in the Disaggregation of A β 42 Fibrils through a Synthetic Paratope
authors: Shivam Tiwari; Bhubaneswar Mandal; K Anki Reddy
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究合成抗体片段对Aβ42原纤维的解聚机制，对象为蛋白-蛋白（抗体-淀粉样纤维）互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上MD可迁移，故评分低。
abstract: Amyloid- β (A β ) fibrils are the characteristic hallmark of Alzheimer’s disease(AD), and most drug development approaches for AD are focused on preventing and reversing the formation of these fibrillar aggregates. Previous studies show that synthetic antibodies have demonstrated great potential to inhibit the A β aggregation and disaggregate the preformed A β fibrils. Here, we perform explicit molecular dynamics(MD) simulation to elucidate the molecular mechanism of disaggregation of preformed LS-shaped A β 42 protofibril with a flexible, hairpin-like synthetic paratope (SP) which, in a recent experimental study, has shown promising results. Our simulations demonstrate various potential binding sites for SP on A β 42 protofibril. However, binding of SP at the amyloidogenic core region (KLVFF) shows pronounced structural disruption of A β 42 protofibril. Our results show heavy loss of β sheet content, dismantling of K28-A42 salt bridge, and destruction of key contacts in the hydrophobic cores of A β 42 protofibril in the presence of SP. We found the aromatic and hydrophobic residues of A β 42 protofibril participating primarily in the binding with SP. Also, we found that π − π stacking and hydrophobic interactions are the most dominant mode of interaction between SP and A β 42 protofibril. This work provides a detailed atomistic perspective on the A β 42 protofibril disaggregation mechanism with SP, and the findings can help develop more effective drugs for AD in the future.
abstract_zh: 淀粉样蛋白-β (Aβ) 纤维是阿尔茨海默病（AD）的特征性标志，大多数针对AD的药物开发方法都聚焦于预防和逆转这些纤维状聚集体的形成。先前研究表明，合成抗体在抑制Aβ聚集和解聚预先形成的Aβ纤维方面展现出巨大潜力。在此，我们进行了显式分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，以阐明具有柔性、发夹样合成互补位（synthetic paratope, SP）的预成型LS形Aβ42原纤维的解聚分子机制，该SP在近期实验研究中显示出有前景的结果。我们的模拟展示了SP在Aβ42原纤维上的多种潜在结合位点。然而，SP在淀粉样生成核心区域（KLVFF）的结合显示出对Aβ42原纤维的显著结构破坏。我们的结果表明，在SP存在下，β折叠含量大幅减少，K28-A42盐桥被拆解，以及Aβ42原纤维疏水核心中的关键接触被破坏。我们发现Aβ42原纤维的芳香族和疏水性残基主要参与与SP的结合。此外，我们发现π−π堆积和疏水相互作用是SP与Aβ42原纤维之间最主要的相互作用模式。这项工作提供了关于SP介导的Aβ42原纤维解聚机制的详细原子视角，这些发现有助于未来开发更有效的AD药物。
